verdict.rationale: Browser autofill of TOTP codes and passkeys is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents a mobile code generator with sync, QR transfer, search, edit and Privacy Screen. Nothing in the pack shows a browser extension, autofill, or passkey support.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them
